source.name: EIA-930 PJM reported hourly demand · 2024
source.source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, EIA-930 historical balance CSV snapshots
source.time_conversion: UTC Time at End of Hour minus exactly one hour; UTC calendar-year crop
source.value_selection: Demand (MW) and Demand Forecast (MW); adjusted/imputed columns unused
source.forecast_limitation: Reported forecast snapshot, not an as-of forecasting backtest or a trained model
source.attribution: Source: U.S. Energy Information Administration; downloaded 2026-10-26. Historical files may be revised; SHA-256 identifies the actual snapshots.

limitations: Same-author contract pilot on real reported data; separate source CSV oracle. Dev/test use different time windows but share metric families. No external question review, no LLM benchmark, no model training, no causal anomaly or forecasting-backtest claim.
